title: Indo-Pacific Command OCONUS Medical Q Coded Services Enterprise Strategic Sourcing Program
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEFENSE HEALTH AGENCY (DHA).DEFENSE HEALTH AGENCY HCD WEST
detail_text: This is a Special Notice of Intent to Consolidate contract requirements. This notice is issued for informational and planning purposes only in accordance with the Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) FAR 7.107-3(b), "Notification to the public." THIS IS NOT A SOLICITATION FOR OFFERS/PROPOSALS/QUOTES AND NO CONTRACT WILL BE AWARDED FROM THIS NOTICE . No proposals or quotes are being requested or accepted with this notice. The Government is not obligated to and will not pay for any information received from potential sources as a result of this notice. Pursuant to RFO FAR 7.107-3(b)(1), the Defense Health Agency (DHA) Contracting Activity (CA), hereby provides public notification that the Senior Procurement Executive (SPE) has formally determined that the consolidation of contract requirements for a strategic sourcing acquisition program for Medical Q Coded services outside the continental United States (OCONUS), including but not limited to, Military Treatment Facilities (MTFs) in the Indo-Pacific Command/Pacific Rim Command (INDOPACOM/PAC-RIM) regions, such as MTFs in Japan and Korea. This is designed to implement a performance-based, strategic sourcing approach with respect to entering into Firm Fixed-Price (FFP), Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contracts and task orders for the services of health care professional staff.
